subject: Important Update: New Payment Methods Available
body: Dear valued customer, we are excited to announce that we have added new payment methods to make your shopping experience even more convenient. You can now choose from various options including credit card, PayPal, and bank transfer. To explore these new payment methods, simply visit our website or contact our customer support team for assistance. We hope this enhancement will provide you with more flexibility and ease when making purchases. Thank you for shopping with us! Sincerely, The Customer Service Team
